messages:
maria.prod: Quick question — for the v1->v2 deprecation flow, do we require explicit tenant consent before we start routing their requests to the v2 fallback? thinking about legal/enterprise needs + console UX.

devin.eng: Short answer: some enterprise contracts want explicit opt-in/opt-out. But operationally we planned a soft roll (canary + opt-in) that prefers non-disruptive fallbacks.

sam.console: From UX POV we can add a per-tenant toggle 'Allow automatic compatibility routing' with a small tooltip. Show last 30d % routed to v2 and a projected cost delta if they flip.

kevin.sre: Important: when we route to v2 we see different token profiles and sometimes higher downstream re-tries. Need to protect tenant quotas and avoid surprise billing spikes. Propose a grace quota buffer for 7 days after first routing change.

maria.prod: Agreement — product wants clear consent for any tenant with enterprise flag, but for self-serve maybe we surface an opt-in banner and default to conservative (no auto-switch) until they opt in.

devin.eng: Operationally the routing policy needs to be able to respect three states: explicit_opt_in, explicit_opt_out, and default_control (our soft-roll behavior). Also need an audit log event so we can prove we respected consent.

sam.console: UX nit: make the toggle actionable from the route overview page and include a small timeline view of when their traffic was routed + reason. Also add a CTA to preview responses from both variants.

kevin.sre: Telemetry requirements: we need a compact event for each decision with deterministic sampling for high-volume routes. Something like:
```
{
  event: "compat_routing_decision",
  tenant_id: "T123",
  client_version: "v1.4.2",
  route: "/generate",
  applied_policy: "explicit_opt_in",
  reason: "consent_toggle",
  decision_ts: 1689000000
}
```
We should include token_estimate and projected_quota_impact fields optionally.

maria.prod: Good. Also include a field 'consent_provenance' to capture how consent was given (console, contract, support).

devin.eng: For storage we can emit full events to internal telemetry (high-cardinality) but send sampled summaries to the metrics pipeline: a counter per policy + histograms for latency/cost. Sampling keys should include tenant_id hash so sampling is deterministic per tenant.

kevin.sre: There's also the billing side — we need a non-sampled high-fidelity trail for tenants that dispute charges. Suggest we write raw events to cold storage for 90 days (audit window) and keep sampled metrics for dashboards.

sam.console: UX detail: when a tenant flips to allow automatic routing, show an interstitial that lists expected cost delta, SLA impact, and the opt-out link. Keep it reversible.

maria.prod: Decision proposal: default behavior = conservative (no auto-switch for self-serve), expose opt-in banner + console toggle, enterprise flagged accounts require explicit sign-off recorded as consent_provenance=contract. Routing layer must respect explicit state and emit compat_routing_decision events.

devin.eng: I'll stub the routing-flag schema + telemetry producer PR. Need SRE to define required audit retention and storage path.

kevin.sre: I can own the retention plan. Will open infra ticket for cold storage + query tooling for disputes. One ask: make the event schema stable (version it) so we can evolve safely.

rollout-bot: Scheduled canary: 2025-07-10T03:00:00Z, cohort=10% self-serve tenants, policy=default_control. Will notify #incidents if error-rate delta > 2x baseline.

maria.prod: Thanks — can we get a short checklist in this thread before the canary? items: console toggle UI, consent_provenance capture, telemetry event v1, cold-storage retention ticket, grace-quota policy draft.

devin.eng: On it — will post PR links + checklist by EOD tomorrow.
